headline: Mythical Hunt
intro: Mythical Hunt demonstrates technical ownership across gameplay systems, UI, multiplayer replication, and team leadership in a 12-week Unreal Engine production.

hero.alt: Two characters approaching a guarded city gate in Mythical Hunt
hero.caption: Co-op tactical gameplay with character switching and enemy encounters.

timeline.title: Character ability foundation
timeline.shortText: Implemented 16 character abilities using Unreal's Gameplay Ability System, then refined casting and targeting from playtest feedback.

media.alt: Ability targeting demonstration in a debugging level
media.caption: Ability targeting, activation, and feedback in a test level.

annotations.label: Targeting
annotations.detail: Ability previews needed to stay readable during fast character switching.

annotations.label: Replication
annotations.detail: Gameplay-relevant actions were routed through server-authoritative RPCs.

timeline.outcome: All character abilities were implemented in time and gained quick-cast improvements after testing.

timeline.title: Steam co-op multiplayer
timeline.shortText: Built a listen-server multiplayer setup using Steamworks and kept movement, abilities, and animation state synchronized.

media.alt: Network replication test for Mythical Hunt multiplayer
media.caption: A replication test showing multiplayer state updating across clients.

annotations.label: Client view
annotations.detail: The local player starts movement immediately for responsiveness.

annotations.label: Authority
annotations.detail: The server validates important gameplay state to reduce desync.

timeline.outcome: The prototype supported accessible online co-op without a dedicated server requirement.

closing: The strongest part of this project is not only the feature list, but the amount of unfamiliar engine surface that had to be learned, debugged, and made production-ready under a short deadline.
